cluster_kind_decision.semantic_fact: A Kubernetes cluster is the runtime boundary containing namespaces and their namespaced workloads; managed-cluster resources represent that same boundary.

normative_evidence.fact: Namespaces isolate groups of resources within one cluster and provide scope for names.
The Kubernetes provider host identifies the Kubernetes API used to manage its associated resources.
The Azure managed-cluster resource exports the Kubernetes host consumed by the Kubernetes provider.
The Google managed-cluster resource exports the Kubernetes control-plane endpoint.
The EKS resource represents a managed Kubernetes cluster and exports its endpoint.
The Azure Arc resource represents a connected Kubernetes cluster.

relations.runs-as: Workload executes under an explicitly referenced identity.
